origin: Original project-authored SVG rolling stock; no external art or generated text.
geometry: Three-quarter roof and end surfaces, curved boiler, layered metal rims, separate wheel pivots and connecting rod. Live words remain HTML above clear side panels.
motion: Rolling stock settles during movement while the parent train translates independently; travel and animation pause together.
review: Directly inspected in all three world scenes on 10 September 2026, including assembled short landscape and moving train views. Words remain readable on wagon sides; wheels, train translation and scene movement have separate ownership. Browser journey, pause, input and completion checks are recorded by the release lane; this asset receipt is not a claim that all 22 games are finished.
